burger.place1: Cinematic late-night photograph inside an American diner at 1 a.m. A double smash burger rests on a sheet of crinkled white wax paper on a worn Formica counter with a chrome edge. The burger: a glossy, deep-golden toasted brioche bun scattered with sesame seeds; two thin smashed beef patties with dark, crispy, lacy edges, each draped in a slice of melted orange American cheese that drips over the sides; crinkle-cut green pickles; soft caramelised onions; a smear of pale orange burger sauce. A wisp of steam rises from it. Behind it, softly out of focus: rain streaking down a big plate-glass window, a wet street outside, the red glow of neon tubes bent into abstract shapes, a row of chrome stools with red vinyl seats, a glass coffee pot on a warmer. Moody light like Edward Hopper's Nighthawks: a warm amber pendant lamp right above the burger, red neon spill from the window, cool teal shadows. Camera low at counter height, front three-quarter view, 85 mm lens, shallow depth of field, the burger razor sharp. The burger sits in the right third of the frame and fills about half the frame height; the left half of the frame is darker and calm, leaving room for a headline.
burger.place2: Show the very same burger whole again, now outdoors on a bright sunny afternoon in a green city park, photographed from high above: the camera looks steeply down at about 60 degrees, so we see the whole round sesame top of the bun, with the melted cheese, the patties and the pickles peeking out around its edge. It sits on a red-and-white gingham cloth on a weathered wooden picnic table, with a few fries in a red paper tray beside it and dappled leaf shade across the table. No bottles, no cans, no cups. Bright natural sunlight with crisp soft shadows and rich natural colour. The burger sits in the left third of the frame and is large and sharp; the right half of the frame is open wooden table and gingham, calm and uncluttered, leaving room for text.
burger.exploded: Turn this into a clean exploded view of the very same burger, seen from the same low front three-quarter angle. Its layers lift straight up and hang weightless in mid-air, evenly spaced on one vertical axis, each layer level. From top to bottom: the sesame brioche crown, the pickles, the top patty with its melted cheese, the bottom patty with its melted cheese, the caramelised onions, the toasted heel of the bun. A few sesame seeds and two small drops of sauce float between the layers. Studio light: a soft warm key light from the front left and a thin amber rim light around every layer so each one separates from the dark background. The stack stands in the middle of the frame, about 80% of the frame height, with wide empty space on both sides.
burger.remove1: Remove the burger and its shadow completely, leaving the empty crinkled wax paper on the counter.
burger.remove2: Remove the burger completely, leaving the red paper tray with just the fries in it, on the gingham cloth.
burger.explode: The burger comes apart: each layer lifts straight up off the one below and floats upward until all the layers hang in an evenly spaced vertical stack, a few sesame seeds drifting between them.
burger.rebuild: The floating layers glide back down onto each other and close into one whole burger, which tilts toward the camera so its round sesame top shows, as the light turns to warm sunshine.

headphones.place1: Intimate night photograph inside a small Tokyo listening bar. A pair of premium over-ear wireless headphones hangs on a minimal brushed-aluminium stand on a polished walnut counter. The headphones: oval ear cups with smooth oiled-walnut outer caps, brushed champagne-aluminium rims, yokes and sliders, plush ivory leather ear cushions, a slim aluminium headband with an ivory leather pad, and a thin signal-orange ring just visible inside each cup. Behind them, softly out of focus: walnut shelves packed with vinyl records from floor to ceiling, a vintage valve amplifier with glowing orange tubes, big wooden horn loudspeakers, a turntable, warm dim lamps. Warm amber light, deep brown shadows, quiet and expensive. Eye level, three-quarter front view so the near ear cup's walnut cap faces the camera, 85 mm lens, shallow depth of field, the headphones razor sharp. The headphones sit in the right third of the frame and fill about 60% of the frame height; the left half of the frame is darker and calm, leaving room for a headline.
headphones.place2: Show the very same headphones whole again, now on a train in the late afternoon: they lie on their side on a grey wool seat by the window, the band arching away. The camera looks down from a three-quarter angle above, so the upper walnut cup cap faces the camera. Low golden sun pours through the window, warm light and long soft shadows across the seat; outside, golden fields and hills streak past in motion blur; a paperback book and a paper cup of coffee on the little fold-down table. The outer caps are solid oiled walnut all over, exactly as in the photo, with no grille and no mesh. The headphones sit in the left third of the frame and are large and sharp; the right half of the frame is calm and uncluttered, leaving room for text.
headphones.exploded: Turn this into a clean exploded view of the very same headphones, seen from the same three-quarter front angle. Both ear cups come apart outward along their own axis, mirroring each other, every part floating weightless in mid-air, in line and evenly spaced, each part turned a little toward the camera so its round face shows. For each cup, from the outside in: the oiled-walnut outer cap, the brushed-aluminium housing, a small matte-black circuit board with a slim battery, the round driver with its signal-orange ring, a fine black acoustic mesh, the ivory leather cushion. The headband lifts straight up above them with its ivory leather pad floating just below it, and the aluminium yokes and sliders float apart at each end. Soft, even studio light. The whole assembly sits in the middle of the frame, about 75% of the frame width, with empty space all around.
headphones.remove1: Remove the headphones completely; the empty aluminium headphone stand stays exactly where it is on the counter.
headphones.remove2: Remove the headphones completely, leaving the empty grey wool train seat in the sunlight.
headphones.explode: The headphones come apart: the headband rises, and every part of each ear cup slides outward along one line until all the parts hang in a mirrored, evenly spaced row, as the headphones turn to face the camera straight on.
headphones.rebuild: The floating parts glide back together into one pair of headphones, which turns onto its side so a walnut ear cup faces the camera, as the light turns to warm golden sunlight.

sneaker.place1: Bold fashion still-life photograph outdoors at noon. A single performance running shoe stands on top of a smooth white concrete wall against a deep, cloudless cobalt-blue sky. The shoe: a chalk-white engineered knit upper, flat white laces, a thick sculpted volt-green foam midsole with a thin black carbon-fibre plate showing as a stripe along its side, a black rubber outsole with fine lugs, a small heel pull tab. Hard direct sunlight from high on the left casts a crisp, sharp-edged shadow across the concrete; the foam glows where the sun hits it. Camera low, exact side profile of the outer side of the shoe, toe pointing left, 100 mm lens, everything sharp. Minimal and graphic, like a sportswear campaign. The shoe sits in the right third of the frame and fills about a third of the frame width; the left half of the frame is open blue sky, calm, leaving room for a headline.
sneaker.place2: Show the very same shoe whole again, now at night: it stands on a wet asphalt street in a narrow city alley just after rain, mirrored in a shallow puddle. The camera is low and in front at a three-quarter angle, toe first, so the toe, the laces and the curve of the midsole show. Neon from the shop signs, glowing magenta and cyan with no readable words, pools across the wet ground; a little steam drifts; city lights glow as bokeh behind. The volt-green foam glows in the neon. The shoe sits in the left third of the frame and is large and sharp; the right half of the frame is darker and calm, leaving room for text.
sneaker.exploded: Turn this into a clean exploded view of the very same shoe, seen in the same exact side profile, toe pointing left. Its parts separate vertically and float weightless in mid-air, evenly spaced and aligned, from top to bottom: the white laces floating free in loose curves, the knit upper with its heel counter, the white insole, the upper layer of volt-green foam, the black carbon-fibre plate, the lower layer of volt-green foam, the black rubber outsole with its lugs. Crisp studio light: a cool soft key light from the front and a bright white rim light outlining every part. The stack sits in the middle of the frame, about 60% of the frame width, with wide empty space on both sides.
sneaker.remove1: Remove the shoe and its shadow completely, leaving the empty white concrete wall against the blue sky.
sneaker.remove2: Remove the shoe and its reflection completely, leaving the empty wet street and the puddle glowing with neon.
sneaker.explode: The shoe comes apart: the laces float up and away, and the upper, the insole, the two foam layers, the carbon plate and the outsole separate vertically until they hang in an evenly spaced stack.
sneaker.rebuild: The floating layers glide back together into one whole shoe, which turns so its toe points toward the camera, as magenta and cyan neon light washes over it.

cabin.place1: Architectural photograph at blue hour on a Norwegian fjord. A compact modern prefab cabin stands on a flat granite outcrop among tall pines above dark, still water. The cabin: a simple two-storey gabled form clad in vertical charred black timber boards, a black standing-seam metal roof with solar panels set into one slope, the gable end facing the water fully glazed with floor-to-ceiling glass, a small timber deck. Warm amber light glows inside, showing a light pine interior with a sleeping loft and a black wood stove. Low mist on the water, snow-dusted mountains under a deep blue twilight sky. Seen from slightly above across the rocks at a three-quarter angle, so the glass gable and one long side show. Calm, serene and cinematic. The cabin sits in the right third of the frame and fills about half the frame height; the left half of the frame is calm sky, mist and water, leaving room for a headline.
cabin.place2: Show the very same cabin whole again, now in the desert at golden hour: it stands on flat sand and rock among Joshua trees and rounded boulders, with a low warm sun, long shadows, a pale pink and orange sky and distant purple mountains. Seen from a new angle: the opposite corner at eye level, from about 30 metres away, so the other long side and the deck show and the glass gable catches the sunset. Calm and warm. The cabin sits in the left third of the frame; the right half of the frame is calm sky and desert, leaving room for text.
cabin.exploded: Turn this into a clean exploded axonometric view of the very same cabin, like an architect's presentation model, seen from the same three-quarter angle slightly from above. Its parts lift apart and float weightless in mid-air, evenly spaced on one vertical axis, from top to bottom: the black metal roof with its solar panels, the timber roof frame with its insulation, the sleeping loft floor with its bed, the walls (charred black timber outside, light pine inside) each pulled slightly outward, the glass gable wall, the ground-floor slab with its kitchen, wood stove and sofa, the timber deck, and the steel screw piles of the foundation. Soft, even daylight. The whole assembly sits in the middle of the frame, about 85% of the frame height, with wide empty space on both sides.
cabin.remove1: Remove the cabin and its deck completely, leaving the bare granite outcrop among the pines above the water.
cabin.remove2: Remove the cabin and its deck completely, leaving the empty desert ground among the boulders and Joshua trees.
cabin.explode: The cabin comes apart like an architect's model: the roof lifts up, the roof frame and the loft floor rise after it, the walls slide outward and the foundation piles drop down, until every part hangs in an evenly spaced exploded view.
cabin.rebuild: The floating parts glide back together into one whole cabin, which turns so its glass gable faces the camera, as warm golden evening light falls on it.

moka.place1: Sunlit morning photograph in a small Italian kitchen. A classic eight-sided brushed-aluminium moka pot with a black bakelite handle and knob stands on the small blue flame of an old cream enamel gas stove. A thin wisp of steam rises from its spout. Behind it, softly out of focus: a wall of hand-painted blue and white majolica tiles in an abstract pattern, a window with half-closed green shutters striping the room with warm sunlight, a lemon tree in a terracotta pot, a white espresso cup on a saucer. Warm golden light from the left, crisp highlights on the aluminium facets. Camera at stove height, front three-quarter view, 85 mm lens, shallow depth of field, the moka pot razor sharp. The moka pot sits in the right third of the frame and fills about half the frame height; the left half of the frame is calm and softer, leaving room for a headline.
moka.place2: Show the very same moka pot whole again, now outdoors at dawn, sitting on a small camping stove on a flat granite rock beside a still mountain lake, with mist on the water, pine forest and a pale pink sky. A new camera position: high above the rock, looking steeply down at about 60 degrees, so we see the top of the lid and the eight-sided shoulders from above and the base is hidden; the black handle points toward the bottom-left corner of the frame. Cool blue dawn light with a warm glow on one side of the aluminium. The moka pot sits in the left third of the frame and is large and sharp; the right half of the frame is calm water and mist, leaving room for text.
moka.exploded: Turn this into a clean exploded view of the very same moka pot, seen from the same front three-quarter angle. Its parts lift apart and float weightless in mid-air, evenly spaced on one vertical axis, from top to bottom: the hinged lid with its black knob, the upper chamber with its spout and black handle, the rubber gasket, the round perforated filter plate, the funnel filled with dark ground coffee, the lower boiler with its small brass safety valve. Soft studio light with a bright rim on every part. The stack stands in the middle of the frame, about 80% of the frame height, with wide empty space on both sides.
moka.remove1: Remove the moka pot completely, leaving the small blue gas flame burning on the empty stove grate.
moka.remove2: Remove the moka pot completely, leaving the small camping stove on the rock.
moka.detach1: the stove grate and the blue gas flame under it
moka.detach2: the camping stove and the blue flame under it
moka.explode: The moka pot comes apart: the upper chamber lifts off the boiler, the funnel rises out of it, and the lid, gasket and filter plate separate, until every part hangs in an evenly spaced vertical stack.
moka.rebuild: The floating parts glide back down onto each other and close into one whole moka pot, which tilts toward the camera so its lid and spout show, as cool dawn light falls on it.
